headline: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
context: AegisAI co-founders developed AI agents that quickly analyze each message as a human would, paying attention to small anomalies that even the most elaborate checklist wouldn’t catch.
